    trunk edges are shared across destinations, then reuse the resulting
    per-dst edge lists for all partitions to avoid redundant transfers."""

    # Steiner-tree heuristic: tree starts at src; grow by cheapest attachment
    tree_nodes = {src}
    tree = nx.DiGraph()
    remaining = set(dsts)

    # Cache Dijkstra results from each tree attachment point
    dist_cache = {}

    def sp_from(node):
        if node not in dist_cache:
            dist, paths = nx.single_source_dijkstra(h, node, weight="cost")
            dist_cache[node] = (dist, paths)
        return dist_cache[node]

    while remaining:
        best = None  # (cost, attach_node, path)
        for dst in remaining:
            for node in tree_nodes:

                if dst in dist and (best is None or dist[dst] < best[0]):
                    best = (dist[dst], node, paths[dst])

            dist, paths = sp_from(src)
            dst = next(iter(remaining))
